model.description: R31.5.1: RbCompartment.applyPresentation(mode:'expanded'|'bar') @ rb-compartment.ts. Branches ONLY presentation (the 'presentation' attr → app.css) + builds/hides the .rbc-bar strip; content moved ONCE into .rbc-content so its DOM+listeners are fixed across flips. renderBar (private helper) derives icon/verb/label proxies that re-dispatch click to the source element → shared behavior (AC-INV-PRESENTATION 5.8). Reactive via observedAttributes+attributeChangedCallback. Marker [impl:uuid:4d7e2a91-...] on the applyPresentation decl (#126).
